```{r data setup}
getwd()
body <- read.csv("BDYIMG.csv")
```

# Model: Full
```{r full model where y is selfesteem }
body_lm.F <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + IMPREAL + DESIRE + GENDER, body)
summary(body_lm.F)

b_lm.F_res <- residuals(body_lm.F)
b_lm.F_fit <- fitted(body_lm.F)
plot( b_lm.F_fit, b_lm.F_res, 
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Full Model Residual Plot",
     abline(h=0))
```

# Model: Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1)
```{r 1 var reduced model}
body_lm.R1 <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT, body)
summary(body_lm.R1)

b_lm.R1_res <- residuals(body_lm.R1)
b_lm.R1_fit <- fitted(body_lm.R1)
plot(b_lm.R1_fit, b_lm.R1_res,
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT Residual Plot",
     abline(h=0))
```

# Model: Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1), Gender (x2)
```{r 2 var reduced model}
b_lm.R2 <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + GENDER, body)
summary(b_lm.R2)

b_lm.R2_fit <- fitted(b_lm.R2)
b_lm.R2_res <- residuals(b_lm.R2)
plot(b_lm.R2_fit, b_lm.R2_res,
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + GENDER",
     abline(h=0))
```

# Model: Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1), Gender (x2), Desire (x3)
```{r 3 var reduced model}
b_lm.R3 <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + GENDER + DESIRE, body)
summary(b_lm.R3)
```

# Model: Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1), Gender (x2) - Multiplicative
```{r 2 var multiplicative model}
b_lm.R2M <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT * GENDER, body)
summary(b_lm.R2M)
```

# Model: Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1), Gender (x2) - Interaction
```{r 2 var interaction model}
b_lm.R2I <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + GENDER + GENDER*BODYSAT, body)
summary(b_lm.R2I)
```

# Model: Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1), Gender (x2) - Quadratic (Body)
```{r 2 var quadratic model}
b_lm.R2Q <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + GENDER + BODYSAT*BODYSAT, body)
summary(b_lm.R2Q)

b_lm.R2Q_fit <- fitted(b_lm.R2Q)
b_lm.R2Q_res <- residuals(b_lm.R2Q)
plot(b_lm.R2Q_fit, b_lm.R2Q_res,
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals of Quadratic SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + GENDER",
     abline(h=0))
```

# Model: Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1), Gender (x2) - Full 2nd Order
```{r 2 var second order full model}
b_lm.R2.2O <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + GENDER +
                   BODYSAT*BODYSAT + GENDER*GENDER + BODYSAT*GENDER, body)
summary(b_lm.R2.2O)
```

# Investigate Body Satisfaction and Gender
```{r bodysat and gender}
cor(body$BODYSAT, body$GENDER)
cor(body$SELFESTM, body$BODYSAT)
cor(body$SELFESTM, body$GENDER)
```
# Model: Log Transformed Equation for
# Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1), Gender (x2) - Quadratic (Body)
```{r log transformation}
body$SELFESTM <- log(body$SELFESTM)
body$BODYSAT <- log(body$BODYSAT)

b_loglm.R2Q <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + GENDER + BODYSAT*BODYSAT, body)
summary(b_loglm.R2Q)
```
# Model: Log Transformed Equation for
# Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1), Gender (x2)
```{r}
b_loglm.R2 <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + GENDER, body)
summary(b_loglm.R2)
```
# Model: Log Transformed Equation for
# Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1), Gender (x2) - Multiplicative
```{r multiplicative log transform}
b_loglm.R2M <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT * GENDER, body)
summary(b_loglm.R2M)

b_loglm.R2M_res <- residuals(b_loglm.R2M)

```
# Model: Log Transformed Equation for
# Self Esteem (y), Body Satisfaction (x1), Gender (x2) - Additive
```{r additive log transform}
b_loglm.R2A <- lm(SELFESTM ~ BODYSAT + GENDER, body)
summary(b_loglm.R2A)

b_loglm.R2A_res <- residuals(b_loglm.R2A)

```

```{r partial residual plots}
b_lm.g <- lm(SELFESTM ~ GENDER, body)
se_lm <- lm(BODYSAT ~ GENDER, body)
b_lm.g_res <- residuals(b_lm.g)
se_lm_res <- residuals(se_lm)
plot(body$BODYSAT, b_lm.g_res,
     xlab = "BODYSAT",
     ylab = "SELFESTM Partial Residuals",
     main = "Partial Residuals of (log) BODYSAT")
plot(body$BODYSAT, se_lm_res,
     xlab = "BODYSAT",
     ylab = "BODYSAT Partial Residuals",
     main = "Partial Residuals of (log) BODYSAT")

```
